name: agriconnect-backend
description: AgriConnect Backend API - Agricultural marketplace platform

scripts.db:setup: psql -U postgres -d agriconnect -f db/schema.sql && psql -U postgres -d agriconnect -f db/seed.sql
scripts.db:reset: psql -U postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS agriconnect;" && psql -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE agriconnect;" && npm run db:setup
